notes.zh-CN: 新增飞书机器人与移动端配对、项目 .github/skills 命令、会话置顶及提问卡片交互优化。本次同时提供 macOS 通用版、Windows x64/ARM64（未签名）与 iOS/Android 包：APK 为调试签名，IPA 为开发签名、只能安装到开发团队已注册的设备。
notes.en: Feishu bot with mobile pairing, project .github/skills commands, pinned sessions and a reworked question card. This release ships macOS universal, Windows x64/ARM64 (unsigned) and iOS/Android builds; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed, so it only installs on devices registered with the development team.
